scenarios.actor: player beginning without a resumable life
scenarios.trigger: the title screen starts a new life
scenarios.playerJob: understand that a distinct Karl life is beginning and enter play
scenarios.intendedOutcome: a viable life starts with explicit seed identity and bounded variation
scenarios.currentBehavior: The engine creates a fresh state and opens the authored Act opening.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The engine stores a deterministic viable seed that selects starting elements and sidequests.

scenarios.actor: player with a resumable saved life
scenarios.trigger: the title screen detects a valid save
scenarios.playerJob: return to the same Karl life without losing causal state
scenarios.intendedOutcome: saved engine, narrator, collection, and future seed state resume together
scenarios.currentBehavior: Engine and narrator state restore from localStorage.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Versioned life state restores engine, narrator, seed, per-life Chronicle, and validated generated results.

scenarios.actor: player combining a pair with an eligible authored recipe
scenarios.trigger: Engine.attempt resolves a previously undiscovered canonical result
scenarios.playerJob: understand what was discovered and how the world changed
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the discovery enters this life and authored completion with truthful story context
scenarios.currentBehavior: The engine records the discovery; the story page and archive show its flavor and optional historical note.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The same result emits stable capability events and updates both life Chronicle and persistent compendium.

scenarios.actor: player repeating a canonical recipe already discovered in this life
scenarios.playerJob: understand that the pair is valid but adds no new collection entry
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the attempt still receives specific narrative yield without false progress
scenarios.currentBehavior: The known element is shown as already written and the narrator may react to repetition.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Semantic events distinguish valid repetition from discovery while preserving narrator story memory.

scenarios.actor: player combining a pair with no eligible canonical result
scenarios.trigger: the verdict system returns locked, near-miss, self, inert, clash, plausible, or absurd
scenarios.playerJob: understand why the attempt failed or what to try next
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the attempt yields specific humour, guidance, or story response
scenarios.currentBehavior: Verdict evidence selects baked, live, grammar, or generic narrator response.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Typed product events expose the verdict and response role without exposing hidden recipes.

scenarios.actor: player making a validated unscripted combination
scenarios.trigger: the invention path accepts a plausible or productively absurd candidate
scenarios.playerJob: understand what Karl invented and how it can affect this life
scenarios.intendedOutcome: a run-local non-canonical result provides alternative progress
scenarios.currentBehavior: The deterministic offline invention floor creates a bounded element when the playtest flag is enabled.
scenarios.targetBehavior: A typed model proposal passes deterministic gameplay validation, remains run-local, carries no historical claim, and may unlock authored consequences.

scenarios.actor: player whose unscripted candidate fails a deterministic invention gate
scenarios.trigger: the invention path rejects canonical recipe, verdict, depth, run limit, or future gameplay validation
scenarios.playerJob: understand the rejection without losing the original attempt's narrative yield
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the player receives an honest mechanical reason and remains ready to act
scenarios.currentBehavior: A non-blocking status/toast explains rejection while Combine remains available.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The validator exposes a stable reason code and the narrator still supplies humour or guidance.

scenarios.actor: player with at least one current unresolved need
scenarios.trigger: the active Act exposes its current narrator pull
scenarios.playerJob: choose a plausible next objective and possible pair
scenarios.intendedOutcome: one clear goal remains visible while multiple solution paths stay possible
scenarios.currentBehavior: The problem rail shows at most the current pull and the narrator escalates hints after failures.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Canonical and validated generated elements are evaluated by the same solve predicates and guidance contract.

scenarios.actor: player who found an age-up recipe before resolving required needs
scenarios.playerJob: understand that the recipe is valid but the current life is not ready
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the player returns to unresolved goals with specific guidance
scenarios.currentBehavior: The outcome lists unresolved problems and the narrator supplies the gate line.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Svelte semantics distinguish valid recipe, blocked progression, and next required goals.

scenarios.actor: player interrupted by a timed challenge or seeded sidequest
scenarios.trigger: a challenge spawns while ordinary needs remain available
scenarios.playerJob: decide whether and how to change priorities
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the temporary conflict creates a deliberate divergent choice
scenarios.currentBehavior: The challenge displays its remaining turns and can resolve or fail through deterministic engine state.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The life seed selects viable challenge/sidequest variation and later surfaces the consequence in the Chronicle.

scenarios.actor: player reviewing the current or an archived life
scenarios.trigger: the Living Chronicle or archive is opened
scenarios.playerJob: reconstruct what happened and why this Karl became distinct
scenarios.intendedOutcome: attempts, discoveries, inventions, needs, challenges, branches, and fate read as one causal life
scenarios.currentBehavior: The default book shows narrator and latest outcome; the archive shows canonical entries, timeline, and optional inventions.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Archived immutable life records remain separately browsable and causally complete.

scenarios.trigger: the master compendium is opened after at least one life
scenarios.playerJob: understand what counts and choose a broad target for another life
scenarios.intendedOutcome: finite progress is legible without revealing exact recipes
scenarios.currentBehavior: Discoveries and fates persist separately; no unified percentage or gap model exists.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Canonical discoveries, major branches, and endings form one denominator; inventions remain a separate unbounded gallery.

scenarios.actor: player whose accumulated state resolves an authored fate
scenarios.trigger: the engine reaches an eligible ending
scenarios.playerJob: understand the surprising fate, why it happened, and that it was collected
scenarios.intendedOutcome: the life feels complete and creates curiosity about undiscovered fates
scenarios.currentBehavior: The ending screen shows authored fate, run summary, and persistent achievement state.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The fate records causal provenance, closes an immutable life archive, and updates authored completion.

scenarios.actor: player who has reviewed an ending or completion gap
scenarios.trigger: the player chooses another discovery, branch, fate, seed, or invention path to pursue
scenarios.playerJob: begin a distinct life with an intentional target
scenarios.intendedOutcome: replay is voluntary and directed by curiosity rather than reset friction
scenarios.currentBehavior: The player can start a new life but no target or seed is preserved.
scenarios.targetBehavior: The selected broad target and new viable seed are recorded without revealing exact solutions.

scenarios.actor: player opening or resuming after active play becomes online-required
scenarios.trigger: the production backend cannot be reached or trusted
scenarios.playerJob: understand why active play is unavailable without losing prior lives
scenarios.intendedOutcome: active play remains blocked while local archives stay safely readable
scenarios.currentBehavior: This target state is not active; current authored gameplay can run offline.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Active play does not start or resume; saves remain intact and Chronicles/compendium remain read-only.

scenarios.actor: player on a supported phone or desktop browser
scenarios.trigger: the application has loaded required local and target online state
scenarios.playerJob: play the same meaningful game through device-appropriate layout and input
scenarios.intendedOutcome: device differences do not change story meaning, choice, feedback, collection, or completion
scenarios.currentBehavior: One responsive Vite application adapts the vanilla DOM UI across viewport sizes.
scenarios.targetBehavior: Svelte preserves identical product semantics and saves across supported devices after differential parity.
